title:
THE BUTTON
NOBODY EXPLAINED.
scriptLine: Button down, bow down. Button up, bow up.

hero.text: There's a button on your throttle nobody explains.
hero.prompt: A white runabout boat seen from the side on a calm lake, its outboard motor tilted up, a woman at the helm, desert mountains and a small dock behind.

meaning.label: WHAT IT MEANS
meaning.text: Trim tilts the motor. That changes where the thrust points, and that moves the bow.

items.label: Trim down: to get on plane
On plane: bump up until the bow lifts and the wheel lightens
Bow bobbing: too much. Trim back down
Revs up, speed down: prop losing bite. Trim down

cta: Get on the list. Link in bio.
